column3: Close to the Hebrew; “My covenant loyalty” is rendered “My lovingkindness.”
Close to the Hebrew; “You have known him … you have regarded him” is rendered “You take knowledge of him … You think of him.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Rout” is rendered “confuse.”
Close to the Hebrew; The plural “your hands” is rendered “Your hand,” and “sons of foreignness” as “aliens.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Falsehood” and “deception” are rendered “deceit” and “falsehood.”
Close to the Hebrew; “A lyre of ten” is rendered “a harp of ten strings.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Sons of foreignness” is rendered “aliens.”
The Hebrew begins “who/that our sons [are]”; NASB renders verses 12–14 as wishes (“Let our sons …”), and “carved corners” as “corner pillars.”
Close to the Hebrew; NASB renders the verse as a wish (“Let our garners be full”), and “open places” as “fields.”
“Loaded … no breach and no going out” is rendered “bear, Without mishap and without loss.” The meaning of the Hebrew is uncertain.
Close to the Hebrew; “That thus [is] to it” is rendered “who are so situated.”
